notes.meaning: John sees a frightening monster rising out of the sea, which represents the restless, troubled nations of the world. The seven heads and ten crowned horns stand for powerful earthly kingdoms and rulers that stand in opposition to God. Its blasphemous names show that this empire openly dishonors God by claiming divine power and glory for itself.

differ.view: The beast represents the Roman Empire in its civil government, which later gave its power to the papacy.
The beast is a real future person, the Antichrist, who will head a ten-nation confederacy in the end times.

other.label: Modern scholarship
other.view: The beast represents the imperial power of Rome using brute force to demand emperor worship from its subjects.

notes.meaning: This beast looks like a leopard, bear, and lion combined, bringing together the speed, strength, and cruelty of the terrible empires shown to Daniel. It embodies all the oppressive worldly powers that have fought against God throughout history. The dragon, who is Satan, gives this beast its strength, throne, and vast authority.

One of the heads of the beast suffers what looks like a fatal injury, but the deadly wound is miraculously healed. This unexpected recovery fills people all over the world with amazement, and they rush to follow after the beast. The healing serves as a demonic counterfeit of the death and resurrection of Jesus Christ.

differ.view: The wounded head points to the end of the line of Roman emperors with Nero, followed by the empire's recovery under new rulers.
The wound refers either to a future revival of the Roman Empire or to a literal fatal wound and miraculous recovery of the personal Antichrist.

notes.meaning: By worshiping the beast, the people of the world are actually worshiping the devil who gave it power. They celebrate the beast as totally invincible and beyond compare, boasting that no one can successfully fight against it. Their chant is a wicked mockery of the songs of praise that belong to God alone.

The beast is allowed to speak arrogant boasts and terrible insults against God. God limits this ruler's period of authority to forty-two months, which is three and a half years. Even during the darkest seasons of persecution, evil powers remain under God's sovereign control.

differ.view: The forty-two months represent 1,260 prophetic years of papal dominion rather than a literal three and a half years.
The forty-two months are a literal three and a half years, corresponding to the final half of the future tribulation period.

notes.meaning: The beast pours out insults against God, dishonoring His holy name and His heavenly dwelling place. Because it cannot reach the angels and redeemed saints safe in heaven, it attacks them with slander. Believers can rest in the comfort that their true home in heaven is far beyond the reach of any enemy.

God permits the beast to wage war against His holy people on earth and overcome their physical lives. Its political control spreads over every tribe, language, and nation across the globe. While earthly rulers may take the lives of the faithful, they can never steal away their eternal salvation.

Every unbeliever living on earth bows down and offers worship to the beast. The only people who do not fall into this deception are those whose names are written in the Book of Life. That register belongs to Jesus, the Lamb who was chosen to be slain in God's eternal plan before the world was made.

John calls for earnest, careful attention to God's solemn decree. Those who take others into captivity or kill them with the sword will eventually suffer that exact fate under God's just judgment. In the meantime, God's people are called to stand firm with patient trust and unwavering loyalty to Christ.

John sees a second beast coming up out of the earth, often identified as the False Prophet. It looks mild, harmless, and religious, like a lamb with two small horns, but its voice carries the dangerous lies of the devil. It uses a gentle appearance to hide its destructive purpose.

differ.view: The second beast represents the corrupt religious hierarchy of Rome that arose to exercise spiritual power in the name of religion.
The second beast is a literal future religious partner who will compel the world to worship the political Antichrist.

notes.meaning: The second beast wields the full authority of the first beast right in front of him. Its whole mission is to make the earth and its people worship the first beast, whose deadly wound was healed. Corrupt religion joins hands with political tyranny to lead the world into idolatry.

The second beast performs amazing supernatural signs, even making fire come down from the sky in front of the crowds. This mimics the genuine miracle of the prophet Elijah in order to deceive onlookers into thinking its power comes from heaven. God's people must test every miraculous sign against the truth of God's Word.

These astonishing signs trick the people of the earth into believing the lies of the first beast. The second beast directs the public to build an idol or statue honoring the beast that survived the deadly sword strike. This brings back the ancient evil of forcing citizens to worship an earthly ruler.

The second beast is permitted to give breath to the idol, giving it the appearance of life so that it can speak. It then decrees that anyone who refuses to bow down and worship the image must be put to death. This severe threat forces every person to decide whether they fear men more than God.

The false prophet forces all people, rich and poor, slave and free, to take a mark on their right hand or forehead. Without this mark, which is the name or the number of the beast, no one is permitted to buy food or carry on trade. It serves as a visible sign of loyalty to the beast and a rejection of the true God.

differ.view: The mark is a spiritual symbol of public obedience to papal decrees and church ceremonies, rather than a physical mark.
The mark will be a literal, physical brand or identification mark required to buy and sell during a future tribulation period.

notes.meaning: John calls for spiritual wisdom and understanding to solve the mystery of the beast's number. The number is six hundred sixty-six, calculated according to ordinary human counting. It points to a human power that continually falls short of God's holy perfection.

differ.view: The number 666 is symbolic; repeating the number six three times represents the complete fallenness and imperfection of human power trying to be God.
The number is an exact calculation based on the numerical values of the letters of a name, pointing to the Latin power or a specific persecutor like Nero Caesar.
